
=== MANA BASE (35 front-face lands + 1 MDFC land-backs, 1 truly tapped) ===
  conditional, not counted: Castle Embereth   [unless you control a]
  TRULY TAPPED: Path of Ancestry
  accelerants counted: 18  (restricted, excluded: fíli and kíli, joyous, mox opal)
  rituals counted, play simulation only (net burst): seething song +2

--- sources model (colour), worst lines (8000 sims over 3 reps, seed 17) ---
  T6 {R}{R}        74.6% ±0.4   Etali, Primal Storm
  T5 {R}{R}        83.1% ±0.5   Mana Geyser
  T4 {R}{R}        89.3% ±0.2   Unexpected Windfall
  T4 {R}           90.3% ±0.1   Big Score, Storm-Kiln Artist
  T1 {R}           92.4% ±0.1   Faithless Looting, Gamble, Lightning Bolt

--- play simulation, 20000 trials over 3 reps, seed 17 ---
  line                                             on play     on draw        baseline(any N on TN)
  Etali, Primal Storm T6                         81.8±0.3%   88.3±0.0%     81.9±0.3% / 88.4±0.0%
  Mana Geyser T5                                 86.6±0.1%   91.9±0.1%     87.0±0.1% / 92.2±0.1%
  Unexpected Windfall T4                         88.8±0.1%   93.2±0.1%     90.0±0.2% / 94.0±0.1%
  Big Score T4                                   89.9±0.2%   94.0±0.1%     90.0±0.2% / 94.0±0.1%
  Faithless Looting T1                           87.7±0.0%   89.8±0.2%     97.7±0.1% / 98.7±0.0%
  Magda, Brazen Outlaw on curve                  91.9±0.1%   94.5±0.2%     93.2±0.2% / 95.5±0.1%

  Diagnosis: a line CLOSE to its baseline is a QUANTITY problem (no land swap will help).
  A line FAR BELOW its baseline is a COLOUR problem (a filter land for that pip is the answer).
  A gap smaller than the two ± beside it is noise, not a finding.

  No mulligan is modelled: every opening seven is kept, so the figures above are FLOORS.
  20.1% of opening sevens hold at most one land (3.7% hold none), off 36 lands in 99.
  Those hands are kept here and shipped back in real play. The share moves with
  land count, so it skews deck-to-deck comparison and not just the level.
